options.label: Operates on the rows of a sheet
Operates on the columns of a sheet

configurable_props.name: destinationIndex
configurable_props.label: Destination Index
configurable_props.description: The zero-based start index of where to move the source data to, based on the coordinates *before* the source data is removed from the grid. Existing data will be shifted down or right (depending on the dimension) to make room for the moved dimensions. The source dimensions are removed from the grid, so the the data may end up in a different index than specified. For example, given `A1..A5` of `0, 1, 2, 3, 4` and wanting to move `"1"` and `"2"` to between `"3"` and `"4"`, the source would be `ROWS [1..3)`,and the destination index would be `"4"` (the zero-based index of row 5). The end result would be `A1..A5` of `0, 3, 1, 2, 4`
